scope: Four actual cached teacher contexts and native RGB grids, lossless official preprocessing and mask/box/API contracts only. No model creation/forward/optimizer/GT score/GPU or new owner.

rules.RGB: Pinned original ffmpeg/native physical sampled frame grid. Lossless ndarray adapter replaces only JPEG file decoding; exact official PIL square resize/float32-buffer/normalization is verified against official helper on PNG files.
rules.prompt: Same eight actual selected ReferDINO native logits, nested padding must be entirely false, native-logit bilinear resize directly to original H,W (align_corners=False), threshold >0. Aspect-preserving teacher resize verified. No new expert.
rules.boxes: Normalized cxcywh, half-open pixel bounds [min,max+1), empty mask zero-area [0,0,0,0], no source fallback.
rules.propagation: Fresh state, all eight initial conditioning masks inserted in physical temporal order before official forward from earliest and reverse prefix; duplicate earliest conditioning output must match exactly. No custom fusion or our DP.
rules.real_execution: NOT released by this CPU preparation plan. Requires separate frozen model execution, exclusive GPU ownership after CG/old768, official CUDA postprocessing support without silent extension fallback, actual first-query bridge and fixed pilot128parents/domain then full cohorts.
